# #471 Rapportsäsongen i full gång – nu ökar pressen

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Avanza-podden #471 covers the start of the Q3 report season. The hosts expect 'sell on news': stocks are punished for results that only match expectations, against a backdrop of AI-capex jitters (neocloud stocks down about 25%, Nasdaq's worst week since April 2025), high long-term interest rates, Brent oil above $110 and the Fear & Greed index at 18. Guest Daniel Zetterberg of Affärsvärlden is neutral on Wallenstam because he sees downside risk in residential property values. In preference and D-shares he recommends buying Sagax D, MP3 pref, Intea D and Emilshus pref, is neutral on FastPartner D and recommends selling Tingsvalvet pref and Insig pref.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 WALL-B — Wallenstam | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Affärsvärlden: neutral. Strong balance sheet and hedged debt, but downside risk in residential values. Base case 20% upside only if the NAV discount narrows.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Daniel Zetterberg (Affärsvärlden): low leverage, ICR 2.8x and long cheap hedges keep the average rate near 3% within three years. But the residential book yield of 3.7% equals the cost of new debt, which implies about a 3.7% ROE and pressure on property values. Both past drivers, falling rates and profitable development, have reversed. Base case NAV 65→70 SEK vs the company's 80 SEK 2030 target.

#### Sell Triggers

- rates keep rising
- residential property values written down
- development profitability worsens further

> *"Men vi landar i ett neutralt råd på axeln, och det gör vi mycket för att vi lutar åt att om någonting så finns det nog snarare lite nedsida i fastighetsvärderingarna."*

---

### 🟢 SAGA-D — Sagax D | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Affärsvärlden buy: passes all seven rules of thumb, about 6.5-7% yield, long dividend record, well run.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst: preference and D-shares behave like perpetual fixed income, so the key is minimising risk. Sagax passes every rule (property cash flows, low leverage, good coverage, size, owner backing, dividend history). Suited as a small portfolio slice, though rate-sensitive.

#### Sell Triggers

- rates rise sharply
- leverage or interest coverage deteriorates
- dividend suspended

> *"Det är Sagax-D, MP3-preff, Intea-D, Emulsus-preff."*

---

### 🟢 INTEA-D — Intea D | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Affärsvärlden buy: passes all seven rules of thumb, about 6.5-7% yield.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst screened preference and D-shares on seven risk rules. Intea D passed all of them and is one of the four sufficient picks, though D-shares rank below prefs because they have no priority and no penalty interest.

#### Sell Triggers

- rates rise sharply
- balance sheet weakens
- dividend deferred

> *"De fyra räcker alldeles utmärkt."*

---

### 🟢 EMIL-PREF — Emilshus pref | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Affärsvärlden buy: passes all seven rules of thumb, about 6.5-7% yield.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst: passes all seven risk criteria. A preference share with priority over common shares and penalty interest if the dividend is cancelled. Fine to own at today's levels as part of a diversified pref basket.

#### Sell Triggers

- rates rise sharply
- leverage rises
- dividend cancelled

> *"Jag tycker att man kan... Det är inget fel att äga de här på dagens nivåer."*

---

### 🟡 FPAR-D — FastPartner D | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Affärsvärlden neutral: passes the rules but has weaker metrics, higher LTV, office vacancy above 10% and once nearly cancelled its dividend.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst downgraded it to neutral despite passing all seven rules: weaker leverage and interest coverage, heavy office exposure with vacancy above 10%, and a past near-cancellation of the dividend.

#### Sell Triggers

- office vacancy rises
- dividend cancelled
- coverage deteriorates

> *"Så av de här skälen stannade vi med ett neutralt råd på fastigheter. partner."*
